title: Refresh subject context pack on every mutating command
description: WHY: getContextPack serves whatever projection is persisted with no freshness check (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 941-950); packs are rebuilt only by context rebuild, doctor --fix, claim-time handoff (apps/cli/src/commands.ts line 11021) and finishReservedWork (runtime.ts line 799 via refreshWorkContext at lines 1731-1744). Plain evidence add, work verify, work close and work edit leave the subject pack stale, so context show silently returns outdated facts between rebuilds. WHAT: call refreshWorkContext (it already exists) for the affected subject inside recordEvidence, verifyWork, closeWork and the work edit path, and stamp generatedAt prominently in context show text output so consumers can detect drift. Cost is one pack build per mutation, which is acceptable at current scale; note the existing rebuild-the-world pattern in rebuildProjections is out of scope here.
acceptanceCriteria: After bwrk evidence add on a fixture item, bwrk context show reflects the new evidence without running context rebuild
context show output includes the pack generatedAt timestamp in both text and json modes
pnpm test passes including a new regression test for pack freshness after evidence add
closedReason: Implemented and verified in checkpoint ffa6c80a.
